source.text_it: Guidando un ciclomotore é opportuno indossare abiti che consentano libertà di movimento

records.localized_text: When riding a moped, it is advisable to wear clothing that permits freedom of movement.

source.text_it: Guidando un ciclomotore è opportuno indossare sandali o ciabatte

records.localized_text: When riding a moped, it is advisable to wear sandals or slippers.

source.text_it: Guidando un ciclomotore è opportuno indossare indumenti svolazzanti per essere più visibili

records.localized_text: When riding a moped, it is advisable to wear loose, flapping clothing to be more visible.

source.text_it: Guidando un ciclomotore, quando si giunge ad un semaforo, bisogna superare i veicoli fermi con la massima velocità consentita

records.localized_text: When riding a moped and approaching traffic lights, one must pass stationary vehicles at the maximum permitted speed.

source.text_it: Guidando un ciclomotore, si può anche oltrepassare la striscia continua, se questo serve a superare i veicoli incolonnati

records.localized_text: When riding a moped, one may cross a solid line if needed to pass queued vehicles.

source.text_it: Conducendo un ciclomotore bisogna essere tolleranti di fronte ai comportamenti errati degli altri utenti

records.localized_text: A moped rider must be tolerant of other road users' mistakes.

source.text_it: Conducendo un ciclomotore bisogna sforzarsi di prevedere il comportamento degli altri utenti

records.localized_text: A moped rider must try to anticipate other road users' behaviour.

source.text_it: Conducendo un ciclomotore bisogna evitare di fumare perché impedisce una presa sicura del manubrio

records.localized_text: A moped rider must avoid smoking because it prevents a secure grip on the handlebars.

source.text_it: Conducendo un ciclomotore l'uso di cuffie sonore migliora l'attenzione alla guida

records.localized_text: For a moped rider, using audio headphones improves attention to driving.

source.text_it: Conducendo un ciclomotore è consentito trasportare animali sul pianale poggiapiedi

records.localized_text: A moped rider may carry animals on the footboard.

source.text_it: Conducendo un ciclomotore bisogna leggere con attenzione i cartelloni pubblicitari

records.localized_text: A moped rider must carefully read advertising billboards.

source.text_it: Gareggiare in velocità con un altro ciclomotore è sempre vietato

records.localized_text: Racing another moped is always prohibited.

source.text_it: Gareggiare in velocità con un altro ciclomotore è proibito anche se avviene su strade extraurbane poco trafficate

records.localized_text: Racing another moped is prohibited even on lightly trafficked roads outside built-up areas.

source.text_it: Gareggiare in velocità con un altro ciclomotore comporta la confisca dei veicoli

records.localized_text: Racing another moped results in confiscation of the vehicles.

source.text_it: Gareggiare in velocità con un altro ciclomotore è consentito solo di notte

records.localized_text: Racing another moped is permitted only at night.

source.text_it: Gareggiare in velocità con un altro ciclomotore è consentito nelle zone a traffico limitato

records.localized_text: Racing another moped is permitted in limited traffic zones.

source.text_it: Gareggiare in velocità con un altro ciclomotore è consentito se il motore è stato elaborato

records.localized_text: Racing another moped is permitted if the engine has been modified.

source.text_it: Se il veicolo che segue mantiene una distanza di sicurezza insufficiente dal ciclomotore che si sta conducendo, è opportuno guardare spesso negli specchi retrovisori

records.localized_text: If a following vehicle keeps an insufficient safety distance from the moped being ridden, it is advisable to check the mirrors often.

source.text_it: Se il veicolo che segue mantiene una distanza di sicurezza insufficiente dal ciclomotore che si sta conducendo conviene, se occorre fermarsi e lasciarsi sorpassare

records.localized_text: If a following vehicle keeps an insufficient safety distance from the moped being ridden, it is advisable to stop if necessary and let it overtake.

source.text_it: Se il veicolo che segue mantiene una distanza di sicurezza insufficiente dal ciclomotore che si sta conducendo, è bene lasciarsi sorpassare

records.localized_text: If a following vehicle keeps an insufficient safety distance from the moped being ridden, it is advisable to let it overtake.

source.text_it: Se il veicolo che segue mantiene una distanza di sicurezza insufficiente dal ciclomotore che si sta conducendo, è obbligatorio accelerare per distanziare il veicolo che segue

records.localized_text: If a following vehicle keeps an insufficient safety distance from the moped being ridden, one must accelerate to increase the gap.

source.text_it: Se il veicolo che segue mantiene una distanza di sicurezza insufficiente dal ciclomotore che si sta conducendo, bisogna frenare bruscamente e a fondo

records.localized_text: If a following vehicle keeps an insufficient safety distance from the moped being ridden, one must brake suddenly and fully.

source.text_it: Se il veicolo che segue mantiene una distanza di sicurezza insufficiente dal ciclomotore che si sta conducendo, bisogna invitare a gesti il conducente che segue ad allontanarsi

records.localized_text: If a following vehicle keeps an insufficient safety distance from the moped being ridden, one must gesture for its driver to move away.

source.text_it: Il conducente di un ciclomotore deve evitare di prestare il veicolo a chi non ha i requisiti necessari per la guida

records.localized_text: A moped rider must avoid lending the vehicle to anyone lacking the necessary qualifications to ride it.

source.text_it: Il conducente di un ciclomotore deve ricordare che la marmitta, surriscaldandosi, può provocare gravi ustioni

records.localized_text: A moped rider must remember that the exhaust can become hot enough to cause serious burns.

rows.text: Suitable clothing should allow free movement and operation of the controls without restriction.
evidence: https://www.dot.state.pa.us/Public/DVSPubsForms/BDL/BDL%20Manuals/Manuals/motorcycle%20Operators%20Manual/English/PUB%20147.pdf p. 5: abiti aderenti ma abbastanza comodi da permettere libertà di movimento.

rows.text: Sandals and slippers leave the feet poorly protected. Sturdy footwear that covers and supports the ankles is preferable.
evidence: https://www.dot.state.pa.us/Public/DVSPubsForms/BDL/BDL%20Manuals/Manuals/motorcycle%20Operators%20Manual/English/PUB%20147.pdf p. 5, Protective Clothing: calzature robuste che coprono e sostengono le caviglie.

rows.text: Flapping clothing can catch on controls or wheels. For visibility, choose bright colors or reflective elements on suitable clothing.
evidence: https://cdn2.yamaha-motor.eu/prod/owner-manuals/Motorcycles/PBT4F8199E0E.PDF p. 1-2: abiti larghi possono impigliarsi; https://safety.army.mil/OFF-DUTY/Motorcycles/Pamphlets-Checklists/Surviving-Riding-Book Clothing: colori vivaci e materiali riflettenti migliorano la visibilità.

rows.text: The maximum limit is not a target speed: approaching traffic lights, adapt your speed to traffic and be able to stop safely.
evidence: https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-141.php commi 1-3: velocità adeguata alle condizioni e controllo del veicolo; https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-148.php comma 11: limite al superamento delle code al semaforo.

rows.text: A queue alone does not permit crossing a solid line. If it is paired with a broken line, it may be crossed from the broken-line side, provided the other traffic rules are respected.
evidence: https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-40.php commi 4 e 8: la continua affiancata da discontinua può essere oltrepassata dal lato della discontinua, nel rispetto delle altre norme.

rows.text: Staying calm when others make mistakes helps avoid aggressive reactions and handle the situation attentively.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/general-rules-techniques-and-advice-for-all-drivers-and-riders-103-to-158 regola 147: pazienza e niente reazioni aggressive agli errori altrui.

rows.text: Watching others and anticipating their possible movements gives you more time to recognize and respond to danger.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/377665/national-standard-for-riding-mopeds-and-motorcycles.pdf elemento 4.2.1: osservare e prevedere i possibili pericoli.

rows.text: Smoking occupies a hand needed to control the handlebars. On a two-wheeled moped, normally hold them with both hands, except when a maneuver or signal requires otherwise.
evidence: https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-170.php comma 1: entrambe le mani sul manubrio salvo necessità di manovre o segnalazioni.

rows.text: Headphones do not improve attention: they can distract from riding. The road code prohibits a rider from using them.
evidence: https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-173.php comma 2: divieto di cuffie sonore alla guida; https://www.hse.gov.uk/roadsafety/employer/make-sure-drivers-riders-are-safe.htm Distractions: l’audio può distrarre.

rows.text: An animal cannot travel loose on the footboard: on a two-wheeled moped it must be kept in a suitable, secured cage or container within the prescribed load limits.
evidence: https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-170.php commi 1 e 5: libero uso degli arti e animali in gabbia o contenitore entro i limiti di carico.

rows.text: Reading billboards takes your eyes off the road. Keep your attention on traffic and hazards that may appear.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/377665/national-standard-for-riding-mopeds-and-motorcycles.pdf elemento 4.2.1: osservare lo spazio di guida e restare concentrati.

rows.text: In normal road traffic, speed racing is prohibited; organized competitions are subject to specific authorization rules.
evidence: https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-141.php comma 5: divieto di gareggiare in velocità; https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-9.php: competizioni su strada soggette ad autorizzazione.

rows.text: Light traffic does not make a speed race on the road lawful: the prohibition also applies on roads outside built-up areas.
evidence: https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-141.php comma 5 e https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-9-ter.php comma 1: divieto di gareggiare e reato per gare in velocità con veicoli a motore.

rows.text: For an unlawful speed race involving motor vehicles, conviction entails confiscation of participants’ vehicles, with an exception for an owner unconnected to the offense who did not lend them for that purpose.
evidence: https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-9-ter.php commi 1 e 3: confisca con condanna ed eccezione per proprietario estraneo.

rows.text: Nighttime does not authorize speed racing on the road: the prohibition does not depend on the time.
evidence: https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-141.php comma 5 e https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-9-ter.php comma 1: divieto di gareggiare in velocità.

rows.text: A limited-traffic zone does not authorize speed races: traffic rules apply there too.
evidence: https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-141.php comma 5 e https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-9-ter.php comma 1: divieto di gareggiare in velocità.

rows.text: Modifying the engine does not authorize racing on the road. The prohibition on speed racing still applies.
evidence: https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-141.php comma 5 e https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-9-ter.php comma 1: divieto di gareggiare in velocità.

rows.text: Frequent mirror checks help you monitor the situation behind and choose a safe maneuver, without neglecting what is happening ahead.
evidence: https://www.dot.state.pa.us/Public/DVSPubsForms/BDL/BDL%20Manuals/Manuals/motorcycle%20Operators%20Manual/English/PUB%20147.pdf sezione Using Your Mirrors: controlli frequenti e attenzione prioritaria davanti.

rows.text: Letting a vehicle that is following too closely pass removes that insufficient gap behind you. You can leave the roadway or use a suitable parking area when it is safe to do so.
evidence: https://assets.dps.mn.gov/files/dvs/motorcycle-manual.pdf pp. 13–14, Being Followed: lasciare passare chi segue troppo vicino, anche uscendo dalla carreggiata o usando un’area di parcheggio.

rows.text: Letting a vehicle that follows too closely pass, when safe, removes its immediate pressure from behind.
evidence: https://www.dot.state.pa.us/Public/DVSPubsForms/BDL/BDL%20Manuals/Manuals/motorcycle%20Operators%20Manual/English/PUB%20147.pdf sezione Being Followed: lasciare passare chi segue troppo da vicino.

rows.text: There is no obligation to accelerate: you may simply end up with the vehicle too close at a higher speed. Let it pass when safe.
evidence: https://www.dot.state.pa.us/Public/DVSPubsForms/BDL/BDL%20Manuals/Manuals/motorcycle%20Operators%20Manual/English/PUB%20147.pdf sezione Being Followed: accelerare mantiene il veicolo troppo vicino a velocità maggiore; agevolarne il passaggio.

rows.text: Braking sharply without need can cause a rear-end collision if the following vehicle is too close. Instead, create space and help it pass.
evidence: https://www.dot.state.pa.us/Public/DVSPubsForms/BDL/BDL%20Manuals/Manuals/motorcycle%20Operators%20Manual/English/PUB%20147.pdf sezione Being Followed: aumentare lo spazio davanti e favorire il passaggio del veicolo vicino; https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-154.php comma 5: evitare brusche frenate durante le manovre.

rows.text: Gesturing at the following driver can take a hand off the handlebars and distract you. Keep control and facilitate passing when safely possible.
evidence: https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-170.php comma 1: entrambe le mani sul manubrio salvo necessità; https://www.dot.state.pa.us/Public/DVSPubsForms/BDL/BDL%20Manuals/Manuals/motorcycle%20Operators%20Manual/English/PUB%20147.pdf sezione Being Followed: lasciare passare il veicolo troppo vicino.

rows.text: Before lending a moped, check that the person meets the driving requirements: entrusting it to someone without the required license is prohibited.
evidence: https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-116.php comma 14: divieto di affidamento a persona priva della patente richiesta o di altra abilitazione prescritta.

rows.text: The exhaust becomes very hot during use and can cause contact burns even after riding. Avoid touching it until it has cooled.
evidence: https://cdn2.yamaha-motor.eu/prod/owner-manuals/Motorcycles/PBT4F8199E0E.PDF p. 1-2: scarico caldo durante e dopo l’uso può causare ustioni.

issues: 27224: The explanation states a blanket prohibition on crossing a solid lane boundary. Article 40(4),(8) permits crossing the paired continuous and broken lines from the broken-line side. Clarify the direction/marking exception in all languages while preserving the printed false verdict; a queue alone grants no exception. https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-40.php

27222 and 27249: The cited Yamaha PDF https://www2.yamaha-motor.co.jp/Manual/pdf/mc/2021B3L6.pdf could not be inspected: the browser rejected it as too large and direct network access failed. A different Yamaha manual supports the loose-clothing and hot-exhaust claims (https://cdn2.yamaha-motor.eu/prod/owner-manuals/Motorcycles/PBT4F8199E0E.PDF, p. 1-2), but the exact cited evidence remains unverified. Inspect the cited PDF or replace it with a directly verifiable supporting reference and review again.

prior_review_findings.author: gpt-6.1-terra / 01a1ea48-f4f7-7ee3-b773-e139dd666782
issues: 27221: The cited PennDOT page recommends sturdy ankle-covering footwear, but does not support the additional claim that sandals and slippers may not stay securely on. Supply a source for that specific claim or remove it in all languages.

27243: The cited PennDOT Being Followed section recommends changing lanes or slowing to create space and encourage passing; it does not recommend stopping to let a tailgater pass. Article 157 addresses stopping rules, not this defensive-riding recommendation. Supply authoritative support for stopping in this situation or revise the explanation and evidence consistently in all languages.
